product_overview: SRT2Web is a modular pipeline that ingests SRT streams, processes them with AI-powered modules (transcription, translation, TTS, mixing), and outputs HLS for browser playback with runtime configuration and real-time log streaming.
core_goals: Ingest live SRT streams and produce HLS output for web playback
Provide a modular, hot-reloadable pipeline for transcription, translation, TTS, and subtitle generation
Allow runtime enable/disable of processing modules without restarting the service
Expose REST APIs for pipeline control, configuration management, module management, and SRT connection info
Stream real-time logs over WebSockets for operator visibility

features.name: SRT Stream Processing Pipeline
features.description: Start, stop, and monitor the end-to-end pipeline that receives SRT, runs enabled processing modules, and outputs HLS.
user_flows: POST /api/start with body {"srt_url":"srt://0.0.0.0:9999"} -> Receive 200 {"status":"started","srt_url":"srt://0.0.0.0:9999"} -> GET /api/status -> Receive 200 pipeline status object including {"running":true,"hls_url":"http://host/stream.m3u8"} -> POST /api/stop -> Receive 200 {"status":"stopped"}

POST /api/start with body {"srt_url":"srt://0.0.0.0:9999"} when pipeline is already running -> Receive 400 with message "Pipeline already running" -> GET /api/status -> Receive 200 pipeline status object showing running:true

features.name: Configuration Management
features.description: View and update the pipeline configuration at runtime with hot-reloadable settings.
user_flows: GET /api/config -> Receive 200 with current configuration object -> PUT /api/config with body {"log_level":"DEBUG"} -> Receive 200 {"status":"updated","config":{...}} -> GET /api/config -> Receive 200 with updated configuration showing "log_level":"DEBUG"
PUT /api/config with invalid body (malformed keys or wrong types) -> Receive 400 with validation error describing invalid fields

features.name: Module Management
features.description: List processing modules and enable or disable them at runtime.
user_flows: GET /api/modules -> Receive 200 list of modules and their enabled/disabled status -> PUT /api/modules/transcriber/toggle with body {"enabled":true} -> Receive 200 updated module state for 'transcriber' -> GET /api/modules -> Receive 200 list with 'transcriber' marked enabled
PUT /api/modules/unknown_module/toggle with body {"enabled":true} -> Receive 404 with message "Module not found"

features.name: SRT Connection Info
features.description: Retrieve SRT connection details (ports/URLs/latency) for external encoders like OBS or vMix.
user_flows: GET /api/srt-info when pipeline is not started -> Receive 200 {"mode":"inactive","port":null,"latency_ms":null,"obs_url":null,"vmix_url":null}

features.name: WebSocket Log Streaming
features.description: Stream real-time pipeline logs over a WebSocket connection for monitoring and debugging.
user_flows: CONNECT ws://{host}/ws/logs -> Receive 101 Switching Protocols then stream JSON log messages (e.g. {"ts":"...","level":"INFO","msg":"pipeline started"}) -> CLOSE websocket -> Receive close code 1000
CONNECT ws://{host}/ws/logs when no pipeline/logs available -> Receive immediate close with code 1011 and message "no logs available"

features.name: Processing Modules (transcription, translation, TTS, mixing, muxing)
features.description: AI-driven audio/video processing modules run as part of the pipeline; modules can be enabled/disabled and their runtime status is visible via APIs.
user_flows: PUT /api/modules/transcriber/toggle with body {"enabled":true} -> Receive 200 updated module state -> POST /api/start with body {"srt_url":"srt://0.0.0.0:9999"} -> Receive 200 {"status":"started"} -> GET /api/status -> Receive 200 pipeline status object including module statuses (e.g. {"modules":{"transcriber":"active","translator":"idle"}})
POST /api/start with required module disabled (e.g. transcriber disabled while config requires it) -> Receive 500 with message "Failed to start: required modules missing: transcriber"
